data.name: Bit Storm VR: First Loop
data.detailed_description:
Thrown into a crumbling galaxy on the brink of annihilation, you will find yourself in a mysterious web of time paradoxes and anomalies which will unravel the fate of the Atlastrian Galaxy. Confusion and chaos ensue as the majority of the Atlastrian Fleet has been replaced by robotic machinery that has suddenly turned rogue and now poses an immediate threat to all life in the galaxy. It's up to you to solve the puzzle of time and carry with you the fate of the entire galaxy. With over a dozen unique weapons and abilities at your disposal you have a diverse array of combat styles and player choices allowing you to become the hero you choose to be and save
the galaxy with your own customized form.

Game Features:

  • Fast-paced, Action-packed Gameplay
  • Intuitive Two-handed Aiming
  • Realistic Sword Combat
  • Three Challenging Difficulties
  • Touchpad and Teleportation Locomotion
  • Thirteen Exclusive Weapons- each offering their own unique playstyle and leveling system
  • Four Story-driven Levels.
  • Rich and Entertaining Characters
  • Environment that switches from day to night

Are you ready for the Storm?

Arm yourself with an arsenal of weapons and devastating abilities that allow for dozens of play styles. Come enjoy a fresh, fun experience in the Atlastrian Galaxy!

reviews.review:
[h1] Experienced on the Oculus Rift with Touch Controllers [/h1]

I do recommend this game on sale. I got it for $3.59 USD and if you can find it at the price or lower then you should definitely pull the trigger. Make no mistake about it, this game is hard even on normal. I didn't try the game on easy, but on normal difficulty you will die a lot just to get past the first level.

Unless you're an expert shot and a master at avoiding damage, you will need to upgrade your weapons before you can successfully clear the area. There's just an endless onslaught of enemies that spawn from everywhere. It is not rare that you die because you ran out of bullets. 

I used free locomotion to run around. However, you do need to set up full roomscale because you can't turn with the joystick. And you need to be accurate to quickly take down enemies, in front, behind, and to your sides. So you need to be able to quickly turn and run in that direction. 

Be warned, there is a lot of backtracking. I think this is to artificially inflate the length of the game. Even after upgrading my guns, I found that I was going back to a place that I had just been to collect another item in that same area. However, I found the fast-paced action to be fun, even it was frustratingly difficult at times. 

Luckily, upgrading isn't too difficult and easy especially after you upgrade the first few times. Then you're able to kill more enemies and killing more enemies leads to more upgrades. So it's slow at the start, but then you're able to upgrade several things, making life all that much easier and more fun as well. 

So you do need patience to play this game. I enjoyed the Duke Nuke'em style voiceover. It's an arcadey, action bullet hell story FPS game. Heavy emphasis on the action part. The graphics were just okay but on the bright side there was a nice variety of enemy types and weapons to unlock. You also get special abilities you can unlock and upgrade as well.

Rate 6/10. Buy on sale and enjoy the challenging arcade action shoot em up fun.
